request: why do prime numbers make spirals?

beats.intent: The primes up to 2000 plotted as points at angle p and distance p, showing spiral arms
beats.narration: Plot each prime p at distance p from the centre and angle p radians. The primes line up in spiral arms.

beats.intent: The spiral beside 2π ≈ 44/7, the reason for the arms
beats.narration: A full turn is two pi radians, very close to forty four sevenths, so numbers forty four apart land in almost the same direction. The arms come from that, not from anything special about primes.
